summary:
SSE stream corruption when rendering view fragments as Server-Sent Events. Fragment
rendering (FragmentsRendering, ModelAndView fragments streamed by
ResponseBodyEmitterReturnValueHandler / ViewResolutionResultHandler) was added in 6.2.0
(commits 14c1faa5ee / 6ee8786385); the advisory range is 6.2.0 - 6.2.19 and 7.0.0 - 7.0.8.
The fix 1994e0ebd0 only changes that fragment-rendering code, which 5.3.20 does not
contain. Plain SseEmitter/ServerSentEvent data escaping is fixed by the CVE-2026-22735 patch.
